zh_CN:
[b][color=#4fc896]目标：让候选药物获批上市[/color][/b]
候选药物要依次走过 [b]发现 → 临床前 → 一期 → 二期 → 三期[/b]，最后通过上市审评。

[b]项目类型[/b]：立项时选择项目类型。不同类型的起始牌组、终审要求和战斗规则不同，需要不同打法（例如[color=#ffcf73]高选择性项目[/color]猛攻会脱靶）。每个项目有自己的编号。

[b]主线：最后的分子[/b]：LM-001 是公司搁置多年的那个分子。项目获批（或在一期之后的里程碑主动终止）会得到该类项目的[color=#73c0ff]研究证据[/color]；集齐 2 项就能重启 LM-001，证据决定它能走哪条研究路线。

[b]四项核心指标[/b]
· [color=#f2cc66]资金[/color]：每走一个地图节点花 1 亿、过 1 年。资金耗尽 = 失败。
· [color=#5ad99a]疗效[/color]：整局累积。终审要求疗效 ≥ 门槛（起始 60，竞品获批后会提高）。
· [color=#f28c73]安全风险[/color]：越低越好。终审要求 < 70；涨到 100 会被监管叫停。
· [color=#73c0ff]数据[/color]：决定 AI 卡有多强，结束时一部分沉淀为公司数据。

[b]三种结局[/b]
· [color=#5ad99a]获批上市[/color]：成功！沉淀 60% 数据。
· [color=#f2cc66]主动终止[/color]：在里程碑判断不值得继续而止损，沉淀 60% 数据，并把部分剩余资金带到下个项目。
· [color=#ed6b6b]研发失败[/color]：资金耗尽或安全风险爆表，只沉淀 30% 数据。

现实中的药物研发就是在[b]更快推进[/b]和[b]尽量少出现疾病进展（PD）与不良反应（AE）[/b]之间找平衡。
en:
[b][color=#4fc896]Goal: get your candidate approved[/color][/b]
The candidate must pass [b]Discovery → Preclinical → Phase I → Phase II → Phase III[/b], then the marketing review.

[b]Program types[/b]: pick a type when you launch. Each type changes the starting deck, final review bar and battle rules, so each needs a different plan (e.g. a [color=#ffcf73]High-Selectivity[/color] program punishes attack spam). Every program gets its own code.

[b]Campaign: The Last Molecule[/b]: LM-001 is the molecule the company shelved long ago. Approving a program (or terminating it at a milestone from Phase I on) earns that type's [color=#73c0ff]research evidence[/color]; with 2 you can restart LM-001, and your evidence decides its research routes.

[b]Four core metrics[/b]
· [color=#f2cc66]Funding[/color]: every map node costs 1 and takes a year. Run out and you fail.
· [color=#5ad99a]Efficacy[/color]: accumulates all run. The final review needs efficacy ≥ the bar (60 at first; rises when a competitor is approved).
· [color=#f28c73]Safety risk[/color]: lower is better. The final review needs < 70; at 100 regulators halt the program.
· [color=#73c0ff]Data[/color]: powers AI cards; part of it is banked as company data at the end.

[b]Three endings[/b]
· [color=#5ad99a]Approved[/color]: success! Banks 60% of the data.
· [color=#f2cc66]Terminated[/color]: you cut losses at a milestone. Banks 60% of the data and carries some funding forward.
· [color=#ed6b6b]Failed[/color]: funding ran out or safety hit the ceiling. Banks only 30%.

Real drug R&D is a balance between [b]moving fast[/b] and [b]avoiding disease progression (PD) and adverse events (AE)[/b].

zh_CN:
[b]每个阶段是一张分支地图[/b]
从上往下走：第一层是实验难题，中间随机，最后一层是平台建设（休整），然后挑战本阶段 [color=#ed6b6b]BOSS[/color]，最后到达里程碑。

[b]节点类型[/b]
· [color=#d98c73]实验难题[/color]：普通战斗，赢了选卡。
· [color=#f9b840]关键难关[/color]：精英战斗，更难，但能拿研发能力。
· [color=#5aadf2]研究[/color]：三选一研究方案并拿一张卡；[b]前期研究会削弱本阶段 Boss 的生命（最多 30%）[/b]。
· [color=#f2b84c]事件[/color]：随机事件。
· [color=#66d18c]合作融资[/color]：拿投资、买卡或删卡。
· [color=#73ccbf]平台建设[/color]：安全评估（安全风险 -25）、升级卡或梳理流程。
· [color=#f280cc]加速通道[/color]：后续节点不耗时，但 Boss 更强。

[b]时间与资金[/b]
每个节点花几个月，满一年扣 2 亿年度成本，竞品也会推进。资金耗尽 = 失败。
en:
[b]Each stage is a branching map[/b]
Walk down: the first row is challenges, the middle is random, the last row is rest (Platform), then the stage [color=#ed6b6b]BOSS[/color], then the milestone.

[b]Node types[/b]
· [color=#d98c73]Challenge[/color]: normal fight, pick a card.
· [color=#f9b840]Critical Hurdle[/color]: elite fight, harder, grants an ability.
· [color=#5aadf2]Research[/color]: pick a plan and a card; [b]research weakens this stage's boss HP (up to 30%)[/b].
· [color=#f2b84c]Event[/color]: random event.
· [color=#66d18c]Partner[/color]: funding, buy or remove cards.
· [color=#73ccbf]Platform[/color]: Safety Review (risk -25), upgrade a card, or build process.
· [color=#f280cc]Fast track[/color]: later nodes cost no time, but the boss is stronger.

[b]Time and money[/b]
Nodes take months; each full year costs 2 funding and moves competitors. Run out of funding and you fail.

zh_CN:
[b]战斗规则（类似杀戮尖塔）[/b]
· 每回合 3 点[color=#f2cc66]能量[/color]、抽 5 张牌，打出卡牌消耗能量，最后点「结束回合」（快捷键 E）。
· 敌人头顶的[b]意图[/b]告诉你它下回合要干什么：红色数字是伤害，盾牌是护盾，箭头是增益，水滴是给你上负面状态。
· [color=#7fb3ff]护盾[/color]能挡伤害，但到你下回合开始就清零。挡不住的伤害会直接变成[color=#f28c73]安全风险[/color]——它就是你的血量，涨到 100 项目就被叫停。
· 开局[color=#5ad99a]力量[/color]来自项目疗效：疗效越高，每次伤害越高。

[b]五个阶段 Boss，各有绝招[/b]
[color=#9b6cf2]发现 · 活性悬崖[/color]：一回合打出超过 3 张攻击牌会反噬。
[color=#8ed14a]临床前 · 毒性风暴[/color]：给你叠中毒，每 3 回合一记器官毒性重击。
[color=#ee4a4a]一期 · 剂量限制性毒性[/color]：可以加剂量，你和它一起变强；锁定的剂量带进二期。
[color=#4a8df0]二期 · 疾病进展[/color]：每回合越来越强，还往你牌堆塞不良反应。
[color=#58c9b9]三期 · 多中心试验[/color]：三个中心一起上，没被攻击到的中心会加护盾。

地图右侧随时可以看到本阶段 Boss 的预告。
en:
[b]Combat (Slay the Spire style)[/b]
· Each turn: 3 [color=#f2cc66]energy[/color], draw 5. Cards cost energy; press End Turn (E) when done.
· Enemy [b]intents[/b] show next turn's plan: red numbers are damage, shields are Block, arrows are buffs, drops are debuffs on you.
· [color=#7fb3ff]Block[/color] absorbs damage but resets on your next turn. Unblocked damage becomes [color=#f28c73]safety risk[/color] — your HP. At 100 the program is halted.
· Starting [color=#5ad99a]Strength[/color] comes from project efficacy: higher efficacy, harder hits.

[b]Five stage bosses, each with a twist[/b]
[color=#9b6cf2]Discovery · Activity Cliff[/color]: more than 3 attacks in a turn backfires.
[color=#8ed14a]Preclinical · Toxicity Storm[/color]: stacks Poison, Organ Toxicity every 3 turns.
[color=#ee4a4a]Phase I · Dose-Limiting Toxicity[/color]: raise the dose to buff both sides; the locked dose carries into Phase II.
[color=#4a8df0]Phase II · Disease Progression[/color]: grows every turn and seeds Adverse Events into your deck.
[color=#58c9b9]Phase III · Multicenter Trial[/color]: three sites at once; any site you don't hit gains Block.

The map always previews the current stage boss.

zh_CN:
[b]五类卡牌，各有定位[/b]
· [color=#8c6bf2]分子设计[/color]：主力输出——伤害、破绽（易伤）、力量成长。
· [color=#f2b84c]实验验证[/color]：护盾与数据，还能抑制对手药效。
· [color=#f07070]临床策略[/color]：中毒（中毒）、抽牌、能量，终点评估可以引爆中毒。
· [color=#4aa0ff]AI 技术[/color]：数值最高，但吃数据、可能偏差。
· [color=#73ccbf]流程建设[/color]：能力牌，整场持续生效。

[b]AI 卡有多强，取决于数据[/b]
有效数据 =（本局数据 + 继承的公司数据）× 数据利用率。
· 低档（< 20）：效果 ×0.5，偏差 30%
· 中档（< 60）：效果 ×1，偏差 15%
· 高档（≥ 60）：效果 ×1.75，偏差 5%
[color=#ed6b6b]偏差[/color]：卡牌效果作废，还会往牌堆塞「噪声数据」或让你受伤。

先用实验卡攒数据、用流程卡提升利用率，AI 才会真正发力——战斗里打出的数据卡会让同一场的 AI 卡立刻变强。

[b]看不清？[/b]右键（或长按）任意一张卡，会打开大图和完整说明。
en:
[b]Five card types, five roles[/b]
· [color=#8c6bf2]Molecular[/color]: main damage — hits, Weak Spot, Strength growth.
· [color=#f2b84c]Experiment[/color]: Block and data, plus Weak.
· [color=#f07070]Clinical[/color]: Poison (poison), draw, energy; Endpoint Readout detonates it.
· [color=#4aa0ff]AI[/color]: biggest numbers, but needs data and may deviate.
· [color=#73ccbf]Process[/color]: powers that last all battle.

[b]AI strength depends on data[/b]
Effective data = (run data + inherited company data) × utilization.
· Low (< 20): ×0.5, 30% deviation
· Mid (< 60): ×1, 15% deviation
· High (≥ 60): ×1.75, 5% deviation
[color=#ed6b6b]Deviation[/color]: the effect is void and Noisy Data or self-damage follows.

Build data with experiments and utilization with process first — data gained mid-battle powers up AI cards right away.

[b]Can't read it?[/b] Right-click (or hold) any card for a big view and full text.

zh_CN:
[b]里程碑：继续还是止损？[/b]
每个阶段打败 Boss 后都有一次立项决策（Go/No-Go）：
· [b]继续[/b]：进入下一阶段。
· [b]主动终止[/b]：项目不值得做了就及时止损，保住 60% 数据和部分资金。

[b]竞争格局[/b]
竞品每年都可能推进、失败或出现新机制。竞品获批会把终审疗效门槛提高 6，之后的 Boss 也会更强；竞品利好或新机制出现会让融资变难。
「AI 竞品情报」能揭示竞品预计还要几年。

现实里，哪怕前期数据很好，竞争落后太多或出现了更好的机制，项目也会被叫停。决定立项后，就要尽全力往前推。
en:
[b]Milestones: go on, or cut losses?[/b]
After each stage boss you make a Go/No-Go call:
· [b]Continue[/b]: move to the next stage.
· [b]Terminate[/b]: stop when it's no longer worth it, keeping 60% of data and some funding.

[b]Competition[/b]
Each year competitors may advance, fail, or a new mechanism may appear. A competitor approval raises the efficacy bar by 6 and makes later bosses stronger; good competitor news or a new mechanism makes fundraising harder.
AI Competitive Intel reveals how many years competitors still need.

In reality, even great early data won't save a program that's far behind. Once you commit, push hard.

zh_CN:
[b]PD[/b] 疾病进展：治疗期间病情仍在加重。
[b]AE[/b] 不良反应：用药后出现的有害反应。
[b]DLT[/b] 剂量限制性毒性：剂量高到病人受不了的毒性。
[b]RP2D[/b] 二期推荐剂量：一期找出的、二期要用的剂量。
[b]ADMET[/b] 吸收、分布、代谢、排泄与毒性：判断分子能否成药的几项性质。
[b]CRO[/b] 合同研究组织：帮药企外包做实验和临床的公司。
[b]KOL[/b] 关键意见领袖：领域内有影响力的专家医生。
[b]IND[/b] 临床试验申请：进入人体试验前要获批的申请。
[b]NDA[/b] 新药上市申请：三期结束后提交的上市申请。
[b]Go/No-Go[/b] 立项决策：决定项目继续还是停止。
[b]多中心[/b]：同一个试验在多家医院同时开展。
en:
[b]PD[/b] Disease progression: the disease keeps worsening during treatment.
[b]AE[/b] Adverse event: a harmful reaction after dosing.
[b]DLT[/b] Dose-limiting toxicity: toxicity too severe to tolerate at that dose.
[b]RP2D[/b] Recommended Phase II dose, found in Phase I.
[b]ADMET[/b] Absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion and toxicity: properties that decide drug-likeness.
[b]CRO[/b] Contract research organization that runs outsourced studies.
[b]KOL[/b] Key opinion leader: an influential expert clinician.
[b]IND[/b] Investigational new drug application, needed before human trials.
[b]NDA[/b] New drug application, filed after Phase III.
[b]Go/No-Go[/b] The decision to continue or stop a program.
[b]Multicenter[/b] One trial run across many hospitals at once.

· 一期里程碑有一次项目专属决策。
en:
Chronic diseases need long-term treatment: each dose is low-risk, but it adds up.
· Each new stage adds residual risk: safety risk +5.
· In every Phase I–III battle, enemies gain 1 Strength every 2 turns, so pure turtling gets ground down.
· Platform rest heals 30; the starting deck has Clinical Monitoring (Block + cleanse) and Dosing Regimen (Poison).
· The efficacy bar drops to 55, but safety risk must be below 60.
· A program-specific decision at the Phase I milestone.

zh_CN: 重启公司搁置多年的 LM-001

LM-001 活性极高，但安全窗口窄、反复失败。靠以前项目攒下的研究证据，才有办法重启它。
· 开局按已有证据选择研究路线：每条路线解决一个难题，也有代价。
· 发现到一期：选择性要求（第 3 张攻击牌起脱靶 5 血，破绽目标除外）。
· 二期、三期：每 2 回合敌人力量 +1。
· 三期最终 Boss「最后的分子」；终审疗效 ≥ 70、安全风险 < 60。
· 获批或在一期之后主动终止，都会迎来主线结局。
en:
LM-001 is extremely potent but has a narrow safety window and failed again and again. Only the evidence from your earlier programs makes a restart possible.
· Choose a research route at the start based on your evidence: each solves one problem at a cost.
· Discovery to Phase I: selectivity rule (from the 3rd attack each turn, 5 HP backfire; Weak Spot targets exempt).
· Phase II and III: enemies gain 1 Strength every 2 turns.
· Final boss in Phase III; final review needs efficacy ≥ 70 and safety risk < 60.
· Approval, or terminating after Phase I, leads to a campaign ending.
